summary: Light Firecrawl pricing page (#f7f7f7) in a centred 904px column (x 224–1128) framed by faint 1px grey hairlines with small corner ticks. Top: a 82px nav bar (orange flame logo + 'Firecrawl', centred links Products ▾ / Resources ▾ / Pricing / Docs / Blog / Playground, GitHub '189K' and a grey 'Dashboard' pill). Hero: centred 44px bold 'Flexible pricing' with 'pricing' in orange #ff4800, grey subline, and a faint dot-matrix world map shimmering in the background. Below, a credits block: a large tabular number (e.g. '3,500') over 'credits/month', a full-width slider (track x 262–1088 at y 339, orange fill to a 16px orange thumb, grey remainder, small tick marks) with labelled stops 1k Free · 5k Hobby · 100k Standard · 500k Growth · 1M Scale · Custom, the active stop's value turning orange, an orange 'Plan: ₹price/month' line and a grey 'Prices shown are per month, billed annually.' note; then an INR flag pill between two empty rounded bars. Below: a 4-column plan grid (Free Plan, Hobby, Standard, Growth) separated by hairlines, each with title, two-line description, credits line, big price '₹0/₹1.5k/₹8k/₹32.1k' + grey '/month', orange 'Billed yearly' toggle with orange 'Save ₹…', a Subscribe button and a checked feature list with dotted underlines. The selected plan's column gets a warm peach tint (#f7f2ee), an orange 'Selected' chip next to its name, a solid orange Subscribe button, and an orange ASCII/dot-character glitch texture rising behind the price/button area. Motion is a cursor dragging the slider: at 0–0.2s it snaps from 21,000 to ~3,500 (Hobby selected) and holds; 1.2–1.4s drags right to 90,000 (Standard selected); 1.55–1.8s to 400,000 (Growth selected); 1.8–2.0s to 790,000 (Scale): the 4-card grid collapses away and a 3-column Scale Plans section (Scale Plans copy / Scale ₹57,744 selected / Enterprise 'Custom') slides up ~90px into its place by ~2.27s with a 'Pay-as-you-go' section beneath; holds to 3.6s; 3.65–4.0s drags back to 86,000 (Standard selected) and the 4-card grid grows back in above, pushing Scale Plans down. The number counts with the thumb throughout; highlight, chip and orange button jump instantly between columns.

criteria.check: Page background is a flat light grey near #f7f7f7, not pure white
Content sits in a centred column bounded by faint 1px grey vertical hairlines at about x 224 and x 1128
Logo is an original orange flame glyph followed by dark 'Firecrawl' wordmark at about x 272–360, y 40
Nav reads 'Products', 'Resources', 'Pricing', 'Docs', 'Blog', 'Playground' in that order, Products and Resources with small chevrons
'Dashboard' sits in a light grey rounded pill at the right of the nav, with '189K' and a GitHub glyph to its left
Headline reads 'Flexible pricing', bold, about 44px, centred near x 675, y 143
'Flexible' is near-black and 'pricing' is bright orange (#ff4800)
Grey subline reads 'Start for free, then scale as you grow.' centred under the headline
Behind the hero a very faint grey dot/character map texture is visible (left and right of the headline), drawn as tiny dots, not a solid illustration or photo
Large dark number reads '3,500' with grey 'credits/month' under it, centred at x ≈ 675
Slider track runs from x ≈ 262 to x ≈ 1088 at y ≈ 339; orange left of the thumb and light grey to the right
Orange circular thumb (~16px) sits at x ≈ 371 on the track
Under the track: '1k Free', '5k Hobby', '100k Standard', '500k Growth', '1M Scale', 'Custom' spaced across the track
Only the active stop's value '5k' is orange with a small orange tick above it; the others are grey
Orange line reads 'Hobby: ₹1,542/month' above grey 'Prices shown are per month, billed annually.'
A small 'INR' pill with an India flag and a chevron sits centred at y ≈ 468 between two long empty rounded bars
Four plan columns of equal width (~226px) start at x 224, 450, 676, 902 with titles at y ≈ 523
Column titles read 'Free Plan', 'Hobby', 'Standard', 'Growth'
Prices read '₹0', '₹1.5k', '₹8k', '₹32.1k', each about 30px dark with a smaller grey '/month'
Only the Hobby column has a warm peach background tint (#f7f2ee); the others are plain grey
Next to 'Hobby' a small chip reads 'Selected' in orange text on a pale orange rounded background
Hobby's Subscribe button is solid orange with white text; Standard and Growth Subscribe buttons are light grey with dark text
Free Plan column shows a grey button with muted text 'Current plan' and no toggle
Hobby, Standard and Growth each have an orange pill toggle with a white knob on the right, 'Billed yearly' and an orange 'Save ₹…' amount
Behind the selected price/button area an orange texture of tiny dots and ASCII characters (x, +, -) is drawn, densest in rows below the button and thinning upward
The texture is discrete monospaced characters and dots, NOT a smooth gradient, blur or glow, and has no outline
Hobby features read '2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped', '5 concurrent requests', 'Basic support', '1,000 extra credits per ₹482'
At the very start the number reads '21,000' with the thumb near x 600, and by 0.2s it reads about 3,500 with the thumb at x ≈ 371
Nothing moves between 0.5s and 1.1s: thumb, number and selected column all hold still
Between 1.2s and 1.4s the thumb slides right about 206px to x ≈ 577 and the number counts up to '90,000'
At 1.4s the peach tint, 'Selected' chip and orange Subscribe button have jumped from Hobby to the Standard column, and the line reads 'Standard: ₹8,001/month'
Between 1.55s and 1.8s the thumb moves to x ≈ 716, the number reads '400,000', and Growth becomes the selected column with 'Growth: ₹32,101/month'

Around 2.0s, as the thumb passes 1M, the 4-column plan grid disappears and is replaced by a 3-column Scale Plans section; the content slides up about 90px (Scale Plans heading from y ≈ 612 at 2.13s to y ≈ 523 by 2.3s)
At 2.95s the number reads '790,000', thumb at x ≈ 849, '1M' is orange and the line reads 'Scale: ₹57,744/month'
Left column heading 'Scale Plans' (~20px) with grey paragraph starting 'High-volume plans for teams that need more power and dedicated support.' and an orange 'Need more? Contact us' link near y 957
The middle 'Scale' column is peach-tinted with a 'Selected' chip, price '₹57,744 /month', orange toggle, orange 'Subscribe' button and the orange glyph texture behind it
Right column 'Enterprise' shows 'Power at your pace with custom solutions', a large 'Custom' price and a grey 'Contact sales' button
Below the plans a section with an icon and heading 'Pay-as-you-go' and a grey paragraph 'Keep accessing web data with search and scrape when your credits run out…' starts at y ≈ 1010
Between 2.3s and 3.6s the layout holds still (only the faint background texture may flicker)
Between 3.65s and 4.0s the thumb is dragged back left and the 4-column plan grid grows back in above, pushing the Scale Plans section down off the bottom (at 3.83s Scale Plans heading is near y 1000)
At the end the number reads '86,000', thumb near x 570, and Standard is the selected column with orange Subscribe
The highlight changes between columns instantly (no sliding highlight box travelling across columns)
A hand-pointer cursor rides with the slider thumb throughout the drags
